brief: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: What is the WhatsApp number customers should order on, the full shop address in Pune, and the days and hours the shop is open?
What does the shop sell, item by item? For each one, please share the name, category (kurta, saree, cotton shirt or dupatta), price, sizes available, and whether it is a new arrival.
What are the return and exchange rules (for example how many days, and what condition items must be in), and what measurements go in the size guide (chest, waist, length for each size)?
How should we handle product photos, lookbook outfits and customer reviews?
questions_to_user.answer:
Address: 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005. Phone: +91 20 4000 7788. Instagram: @threadandloom.pune
Timings: 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday. Closed on Monday.
Products (₹, sizes):
Kurtas: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499 (S-XXL), Mustard handloom kurta 1,699 (S-XL), White chikankari kurta 2,199 (XS-XL)
Sarees: Maheshwari cotton saree 3,499, Chanderi silk-cotton saree 4,999, Ikat handloom saree 3,999 (free size)
Shirts: Khadi cotton shirt 1,299 (S-XXL), Linen-blend shirt 1,599 (M-XXL)
Dupattas: Ajrakh dupatta 899, Bandhani dupatta 1,099 (free size)
New arrivals: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
Size guide (chest in inches): XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
Orders: WhatsApp +91 98220 33445 with product, size and quantity. Pay on delivery or UPI. Delivery across Pune in 2 days, ₹79 charge, free above ₹2,999.
Returns: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags. No returns on sale items.
Reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K. / "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S. / "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
Photos: not yet, leave empty photo spots. Lookbook: 3 outfit ideas built from the products above.

limits_hit: Only you can close what's left: these done-when items are to be confirmed.

used.changes: Dropped Animations and Stories, split Core sections into one workflow per section, and put the viewport meta in the scaffold so no separate Viewport fix is needed.
